title: Sign projection as an inner product
statement: For every vector $t$ in the real two-dimensional correlation plane and every pair of signs $(x,y)$, the projection $x t_1+y t_2$ equals the inner product of $t$ with the vector $(x,y)$, where signs are viewed as real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ belongs to the real two-dimensional correlation plane
